extension.description: Background service for Ultimate VOD that automatically syncs your VOD library with Kodi using the crawler API. Features incremental updates, cross-process safety, and configurable schedules. Supports movies, TV shows, and automatic library scanning.

Background service for Ultimate VOD that automatically syncs your VOD library with Kodi using the crawler API. Features incremental updates, cross-process safety, and configurable schedules. Supports movies, TV shows, and automatic library scanning.

Hintergrunddienst für Ultimate VOD, der Ihre VOD-Bibliothek automatisch mit Kodi über die Crawler-API synchronisiert. Bietet inkrementelle Updates, prozessübergreifende Sicherheit und konfigurierbare Zeitpläne. Unterstützt Filme, Serien und automatische Bibliotheksscans.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a VOD crawler API endpoint. Configure the crawler URL in addon settings.
Requires a VOD crawler API endpoint. Configure the crawler URL in addon settings.
extension.news: v1.0.0 (2024-01-01): - Initial release - Support for movie and TV show syncing - Incremental updates with 'since' parameter - Cross-process file locking for safety - Atomic file writes to prevent corruption - Manual sync trigger via script arguments - Configurable sync interval (default: 1 hour) - Kodi notifications for sync events - Settings change monitoring without restart - Support for Kodi 18+ and Python 3.0+ - Cross-platform: Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, Raspberry Pi
